nodes.question: What is the focus of the study mentioned in the paragraph?
nodes.answer: The study focuses on the indirect and interactive effects of eutrophication and increasing temperature on high- and low-altitude populations of the butterfly Lycaena tityrus, considering host-plant nitrogen fertilization and herbivore developmental temperature.

nodes.question: What aspects of phenotypic plasticity have been studied in the species mentioned in the paragraph?
nodes.answer: The studies have focused on local and thermal adaptation, dispersal, development times, cold and heat-stress resistance, plasticity in heat resistance, temperature-induced plasticity in developmental traits, and sexual dimorphism.
